review:
The whole franchise squeezed onto a 3x3 grid with five lines – it feels like a quick retro slot, but still packs a 5,000x top win.

Three scatters give at least 10 free spins. Fishermen collect every fish on screen, and if one lands with no fish, the Big Bazooka can blast cash symbols across the grid. Every fourth fisherman adds 10 spins and steps up the multiplier, up to 10x. With only nine spots, every fish matters. 96.5% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
